input.change_text: Removed ability to @-mention MCP servers to enable/disable - use `/mcp enable <name>` instead

output.subject: @-mention MCP enable/disable removed; use `/mcp enable <name>`
output.action_text: Replace `@server` enable/disable patterns with `/mcp enable <name>` and `/mcp disable <name>`. The @-mention path is gone in 2.1.6; the slash command is the named replacement and accepts the same server identifiers.
